notes.albums: Eight albums: fan version (13), kids set (5), retro (9), retro half zip (6), windbreaker and hoodie (2), training set (1), half zip (2), player version (7). One photograph per garment throughout.
notes.aliasFalsePositive: dedupe-0905.py matched p119 to 'Inter Milan 2025/26 Third Jersey' at distance 3. That is WRONG and it is a flaw in the club gate: batch.json lists 'milan' as an alias for AC Milan, and 'milan' is a substring of every Inter Milan title, so the whole Inter catalogue is inside AC Milan's gate. p119 carries the AC Milan crest and went in as new. Check any AC Milan hash hit against an INTER title by eye before believing it.
notes.dedupe: Four hash hits (p92, p98, p110, p115) plus p104 by eye. p96 looks like the live 2009/10 away but carries the Athens 2007 final embroidery, which the live shirt does not - a different shirt, listed as new. p111 is an adidas bwin track jacket, not the live Puma windbreaker, and p113 is grey camo, not the live green half-zip set.
notes.leadImagesAreSizeCharts: SIX of the nine live AC Milan listings lead on a SIZE CHART, and one leads on a fabric close-up: 2005/06 white half-zip, 2006/07 home retro, 2009/10 away retro, 2025/26 sweatshirt, 2025/26 third kids kit, 2025/26 windbreaker and the 2025/26 half-zip set. Every one of them carries 8-9 images with real garment photographs further down. This is exactly the client's standing 'we cannot see the first picture' complaint and it wants a promote-lead-image pass; see stadium-supply-lead-images.
notes.retroHalfZipPricing: The 'retro half zip' album is priced at the retroTop tier (R1000), the same call made for Real Madrid's identical album. If the client meant the ordinary R850 half-zip tier, six listings here are R150 over.
notes.seasonReading: Sponsor pins the era: OPEL to 2006, bwin 2006-2010, Fly Emirates 2010 onward; Lotto to 1998, adidas 1998-2018, Puma 2018 onward. The Puma-era specials and the OPEL training tops cannot be dated from the garment, so those titles carry a colour and are marked seasonConfidence unknown.
